text:
ash_sre: FYI apiserver error spike in eu-west1 right after scheduled cert-rotation cronjob ran ~10m ago. leader-election flapping + controller-manager restarts. noticing GPU pools draining to 0 in one AZ.
deploy-bot: cert-rotation-job/eu-west1 started by schedule (job-id=rot-2026-03-21-euw1) :gear:
denise_sre: logs?
maria_platform: seeing lots of TLS handshake failures in apiserver logs: `remote_addr=x.x.x.x:xxxxx tls: failed to verify client certificate`
ash_sre: paste of relevant snippet:
```
I0321 12:12:01.123456 1 authentication.go:120] client authentication error: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
I0321 12:12:02.234567 1 election.go:342] failed to acquire leader lease: context deadline exceeded
W0321 12:12:03.345678 1 controller_manager.go:199] controller manager exiting: failed to renew lease
```
ben_oncall: restarted controller-manager on eu-west1-a to stop churn, but apiserver still showing 503s for watch endpoints.
carla_ml: inference fleet saw fallback to hosted model endpoints, cost spike ~+18% in the last 20m, a bunch of requests got retried.
denise_sre: any chance cert-rotation picked up the wrong CA bundle? we rotated intermediate yesterday for other clusters.
nash_sre: that's my suspicion — job logs show it pushed a new cert that doesn't chain to our cluster CA for eu-west1. can confirm on one node: `/etc/kubernetes/pki/ca.crt` differs from control plane trust bundle.
maria_platform: action idea: revert rotated certs in eu-west1 to previous CA, bump `leaseDuration` on kube-controller-manager temporarily, and coordinate with infra to pause rotation.
ben_oncall: doing revert of certs on apiserver hosts now (rolling, one AZ at a time). will also add `--leader-elect-lease-duration=60s` override on controller-manager pod as a hotfix.
deploy-bot: rollback triggered: cert-rotation-job/rot-2026-03-21-euw1 -> rollback (initiated by ben_oncall)
ash_sre: after reverting certs in eu-west1-b apiserver pod logs show leader acquisition recovered, controller-manager stopped dying. still seeing a few TLS handshake errors from kubelets though — likely cached old certs on nodes.
carla_ml: ongoing: job restarts fixed most traffic; cost is trending down but inference error rate is still ~0.7% (was 0.02% before).
denise_sre: plan: 1) pause cert-rotation for eu-west1 2) force-restart kubelets on nodes that reported TLS errors 3) re-run rotation after we validate the CA chain in staging.
maria_platform: putting a temporary protective route: route requests to dedicated fallback pool (no GPU) if watch endpoints degrade >50% to avoid leader thrash.
ben_oncall: kubelet restarts done for 30% of affected nodes; watchbacklog reduced.
nash_sre: note for postmortem: rotation job lacked a pre-flight CA-chain validation step and our rollout policy didn't canary across AZs. add certificate chain verification and a smaller canary window.
carla_ml: can we get an estimate on total extra spend from the fallback? need to notify finance.
nash_sre: rough estimate +$1.2k for the hour on fallback endpoints. will send details to finance.
deploy-bot: incident annotated: sev3 - apiserver cert rotation -> leader election + controller-manager instability (clusters: eu-west1).
denise_sre: status: apiserver healthy in eu-west1 after revert + kubelet restarts. controller-manager stable. closing incident after monitoring window. :white_check_mark:
nash_sre: thanks all — will file a short postmortem and create an RFC to add CA-chain validation to rotation pipeline.
carla_ml: opened ticket #INF-4321 for cost reconciliation and to track customer impact.
ben_oncall: will keep monitoring for another hour, ping me if anything flares.
nash_sre: last check: apiserver watch latencies back to baseline, GPU pools reattaching. closing thread. :thumbsup:
